screens.title: 01 全球探索
screens.prompt: Create a high-end polished photorealistic WEBSITE UI MOCKUP, landscape 16:9, not a marketing poster. Use attached reference solely for the accepted LIQUID GLASS visual system: pearl-white dimensional cartographic land, glacier aqua water, luminous transparent organic glass, tiny lemon-yellow accents, sophisticated Traditional Chinese editorial serif headings with clean sans-serif utilities. Brand 漫見 somewhere. Improve usability significantly: coherent persistent header, one active panel, restrained glass effects behind legible opaque text, generous spacing, aligned content, no overlapping widgets, strong foreground hierarchy, fewer decorative arcs. All primary UI copy Traditional Chinese Taiwan. No browser chrome or device frame on desktop. No fake verified-live status, social popularity numbers, or real-time facts. Small footer '視覺提案・影像與資料皆為示意'. Render final UI itself, no annotation arrows. A full desktop homepage, spacious global pearl white 3D globe on right with Asia centered, realistic miniature glass island windows of Kyoto, Busan, Taipei and Samui anchored on the globe. Left editorial headline '下一站，跟著感覺走。', restrained supporting Chinese copy, primary yellow '開始探索' and secondary search. Four country pills. No clutter of overlapping panels. Persistent brand header with 探索 / 近期分享 / 我的收藏 and search icon. Bottom subtle data legend '影像來源狀態・天氣資料時間'.
